name: Build custom installer

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      package_ids:
        description: 'Comma-separated winget package IDs (example: Google.Chrome,VideoLAN.VLC)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Create installer
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate selected package IDs
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          PACKAGE_IDS: ${{ inputs.package_ids }}
        run: |
          $ids = $env:PACKAGE_IDS -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ }
          if ($ids.Count -eq 0) { throw 'Provide at least one package ID.' }
          if ($ids | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$' }) { throw 'Package IDs may only contain letters, digits, dots, dashes, and underscores.' }
          "PACKAGE_IDS=$($ids -join ',')" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append

      - name: Generate the Windows installer
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ids = $env:PACKAGE_IDS -split ','
          $quotedIds = $ids | ForEach-Object { "  '$_'" }
          @"
          # Generated by StackLift. Review this file before running it.
          # Requires Windows 10/11 with winget (App Installer) available.
          [CmdletBinding()]
          param()

          `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          `$packages = @(
          $($quotedIds -join ",`n")
          )

          if (-not (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
            throw 'winget was not found. Install App Installer from the Microsoft Store, then run this again.'
          }

          foreach (`$package in `$packages) {
            Write-Host "Installing `$package..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
            winget install --id `$package --exact --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --disable-interactivity
            if (`$LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Warning "winget returned exit code `$LASTEXITCODE for `$package. Continuing." }
          }

          Write-Host 'Finished. Review any warnings above for packages that need attention.' -ForegroundColor Green
          "@ | Set-Content -Path Install-SelectedApps.ps1 -Encoding utf8

      - name: Add run instructions
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          @"
          # Your StackLift installer

          1. Download and extract this artifact on a Windows 10 or Windows 11 computer.
          2. Right-click `Install-SelectedApps.ps1` and choose **Run with PowerShell**, or run it in an elevated PowerShell window.
          3. The script uses winget to install the current stable versions of your selected apps.

          Selected packages: $env:PACKAGE_IDS
          "@ | Set-Content -Path README.md -Encoding utf8

      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: StackLift-installer
          path: |
            Install-SelectedApps.ps1
            README.md
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
